Gmnotes: Script: Tell players what is physically in front of them and point to each major sheet area. Marlowe stays a PC and default package custodian unless replaced; Sabine can be used in the Prologue only as an optional backup NPC job-giver. Either way, everyone receives the job together. Quick mode: use pregens as written. Guided mode: rename, pronouns, look, motive, and equivalent Experience label only. Do not change stats, damage, cards, class features, or balance during a short public slot. Checklist: Characters selected; Marlowe PC or chosen package custodian status assigned; Handouts confirmed GM-only: What PCs do not know: ward function, soul-economy implications, Bramble Union motives, final ritual threat, Relay Spire hook.

Gmreadaloud: In front of you is your character sheet. It tells us who your character is, what they are good at, what resources they have, and what special options they can use. The most important parts for the first scene are your name, pronouns, ancestry/community/class, traits, Experiences, Hope, Stress, HP, Armor, and your key abilities. If any sheet label is confusing, ask me. We will learn the sheet by using it.

Mechanictakeaway: Introduces traits, resources, Experiences, domain cards, and character options as sheet sections.

Takeawayhelp: Players can read their sheet enough to start Players can identify major sheet areas and confirm a pregen. Percharacterlayer: marlowe-fairwind Marlowe Fairwind she/her Loreborne Elf Sorcerer, Primal Origin Arcana, ward-sense, and the custodian responsibility around the package. Character selection The clever insider holding a secret heavier than she lets on. Flexible ranged magic; the only one who truly grasps the cargo as its custodian. Medium, because spellcasting asks for a few choices. Offer Marlowe to a player who wants magic, responsibility, and a secret-adjacent role without making her the job-giver. Marlowe is for someone who wants to play a clever elf sorcerer with real responsibility around the package and flexible magic at range. barnacle Barnacle he/him Underborne Ribbet Rogue, Nightwalker Shadows, deals, underworld instinct, and noticing when a job smells wrong. Character selection The slippery shadow who's never not scheming, and who will not go near water. Stealth, shadow movement, deals, and getting into or out of trouble. Medium. Offer Barnacle to a player who likes clever angles, sneaking, bargaining, and a little comic danger around his water fear. Barnacle is for someone who wants stealth, deals, shadow tricks, and a character who always has an angle. garrick-reed Garrick Reed he/him...
